items.title: Frank Capp interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Except that Martha Raye, if you know who she was, she was a singer, she used to come

ctx.x: Did you ever have any interesting things happen in those kind of situations?

Not, nothing, you know there was always little glitches that you say oops, I wish I could do that again but you don’t get a chance to do it again. But nothing really momentous. Except that Martha Raye, if you know who she was, she was a singer, she used to come

on the show and the dress rehearsals, the dress rehearsals — CBS. Every office in CBS was closed during the dress rehearsals because they all funneled down into Studio 33 where we were rehearsing because between Red and Martha it was the most risqué, dirty show.
